title: 3-D Plot
description: Answer a few questions and watch the TRS-80 draw a funnel-shaped 3-D surface as a wire grid, one dot at a time.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. v01 and v02 are tape19b saves 2 and 10, in that save order. v02 replaces v01's LINE statement (not in Level II BASIC) with a line-drawing subroutine that v03 keeps verbatim at lines 360-420; v03 restores v01's surface and adds the prompts and the 1979 credit. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology.

versions.label: Draft · Surface with LINE
versions.note: A funnel-shaped surface drawn as a 7 × 7 wire grid with the LINE statement. No prompts or title.
versions.unavailableReason: Source only. LINE is not a Level II BASIC statement: on the site's Model III Level II BASIC this version stops with ?L3 Error in 150. Its payload was saved with a higher program start (pointer base 22204, not Level II's 17125), so it was probably written under a DOS or BASIC extension that provided LINE; that environment was not recovered.
